candidates.decision: An ambitious package of measures to prevent transmission to and within groups disproportionately impacted by COVID-19 was agreed upon.
candidates.evidence: The committee agreed to an ambitious package of measures to prevent transmission to and within groups that have been disproportionately impacted by COVID-19, focusing in particular on ethnic minority communities.
candidates.source_quote: At the 29 October meeting of COVID-O, the committee agreed to an ambitious package of measures to prevent transmission to and within groups that have been disproportionately impacted by COVID-19, focusing in particular on ethnic minority communities.

candidates.decision: Departments were asked for a more ambitious package to prevent disproportionate impacts from COVID-19 for people with disabilities.
candidates.evidence: The Prime Minister and CDL also asked departments, in slower time, for a more ambitious package that can prevent disproportionate impacts from COVID-19 for people with disabilities.
